items.title: Community Stats server had untested stale/unavailable fallback and error-status branches
items.premise: src/community/server.js's createCommunityStatsHandler has ~9 distinct outcome branches (snapshot happy path, snapshot-with-cache stale fallback, snapshot-with-no-cache unavailable/503, oversized-body 413, malformed-JSON 400, /health, /community/v1/health, unmatched-route 404, plus the existing ingest/withdrawal/CORS paths). test/community-server.test.js only exercised the happy-path snapshot, ingest validation/dedupe, and withdrawal — the exact mechanism that keeps the homepage Community Pulse from showing a blank error during a database hiccup was unverified.
evidence: test/community-server.test.js (pre-session: 3 tests, none touching the branches above)
items.constraint: New tests must exercise the real handler over a real HTTP server (matching the file's existing withServer harness), not mock the branch away.
verification: stale fallback returns 200 with status:stale when store.cache is set and store.snapshot() rejects
unavailable fallback returns 503 with status:unavailable when no cache exists and store.snapshot() rejects

L1.recipe: Add one test for the unavailable/503 branch only.

L2.recipe: Add direct tests for stale-fallback, unavailable-fallback, 413, 400, /health, and 404 — every previously-unverified branch.

L3.recipe: L2 plus a fuzzed-body-size test matrix and a concurrent-request race check on the rate limiter.

items.executionEvidence: Added 4 new tests to test/community-server.test.js covering stale fallback, unavailable/503 fallback, 413/400 body handling, and /health plus 404. test/community-server.test.js now 7/7; full suite 911/911.

items.title: Stats period toggle buttons lacked aria-controls linking to the region they repaint
items.premise: public/stats.html's 24H/7D/30D toggle buttons set aria-pressed correctly but had no aria-controls pointing at the data-community-atlas region they update, so screen-reader users saw the pressed-state change but had no programmatic link to what content changed.
items.constraint: Purely additive markup change; no JS or visual behavior change.
verification: all three period buttons declare aria-controls="communityAtlas"

L2.recipe: Same — this item has no meaningful larger version.

items.executionEvidence: Added id="communityAtlas" to the atlas region and aria-controls="communityAtlas" to all three period buttons in public/stats.html.
